public.text: Public health campaigns are not illustrastred as an end -to-end use case. Campaigns are a major mechanism through which countries operationalize population-level health goals and typically involves planning, readiness, execution, monitoring  and response. An integrated campaign example could demostrate how the sharard DPI-H components are reused across programmes
public.suggestedRevision: Consider adding an integrated public health campaign as a layered view example.The example could follow a campaign from planning and population enumeration through readiness, implementation and monitoring, showing how shared DPI-H components such as the Client Registry, Health Facility Registry, Health Workforce Registry, Product Registry, geospatial/reference data, terminology services and interoperability capabilities support the campaign.
